gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent Gliosarcoma; Recurrent Supratentorial Glioblastoma; Supratentorial Gliosarcoma
Participants must have histologically proven glioblastoma or gliosarcoma which is progressive or recurrent following radiation therapy +/- chemotherapy

candidate_evidence.quote: Akt/ERK Inhibitor ONC201 (other names: ONC201, TIC10): Given orally

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have histologically proven glioblastoma or gliosarcoma which is progressive or recurrent following radiation therapy +/- chemotherapy

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To determine the ability of ONC201 to decrease glioblastoma-initiating cells as determined by percentage of neurosphere formation of treated brain tumor tissues compared to non-treated brain tumor tissues.
To assess the ability of ONC201 to inhibit Akt by evaluating progressive disease (PD) markers by immunohistochemistry such as Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog, Akt and p-Akt, GSK3 and pGSK3alpha.

role_evidence.quote: Patients undergo radiation therapy for 10 fractions over 2 weeks, and receive ONC201 PO daily on days 1, 2, 8, and 9.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: ONC201 may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

source_quote.quote: Determine molecular markers of response to ONC201 in correlation to survival such as DRD5 expression
including pharmacodynamic markers such as DRD2 and DRD5
To assess the ability of ONC201 to inhibit Akt by evaluating progressive disease (PD) markers by immunohistochemistry such as Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog, Akt and p-Akt, GSK3 and pGSK3alpha.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: glioma stem cell markers (Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog)

source_quote.quote: Post-treatment tissues will be assessed for Pharmacodynamic markers (Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog, Akt and p-Akt, GSK3 and pGSK3alpha) by RNA-seq and IHC

coder_notes: Active moiety given as the development code onc201 because dordaviprone is not stated in the record. No MGMT or IDH requirement. Radiotherapy and resection not listed as agents. Both arms are experimental and differ only in timing of ONC201 (pre- versus post-surgery), so no control arm. Pre/post tumour sampling is paired for pharmacodynamics, but drug concentration in tissue is not planned. Biomarker candidate_matched flags are on exploratory or pharmacodynamic rows only and do not affect the primary outcome.
